name: Replit
summary: A browser workspace where the AI agent writes the app, runs it and keeps it deployed on the same platform.
description:
Replit's advantage over a code-generation demo is that the loop closes: the agent edits, the environment runs, the database exists, and hosting is a button rather than a weekend. For internal tools, side projects and founder prototypes that collapses a lot of setup work into one tab, and it is genuinely usable by people who do not want to think about infrastructure.

The lock-in is the platform itself, not the model — deployment, storage and auth all live on Replit, and the bill scales with usage rather than with effort. Anything that later needs custom infrastructure, strict data residency or a peculiar runtime tends to be migrated off rather than grown in place.
